heading: Exelcius Automation: Advanced ATCC System Solutions
content:
Exelcius Automation: Advanced ATCC System Solutions

Exelcius Automation is a leading provider of intelligent transportation solutions, specializing in Automated Traffic Counter and Classifier (ATCC) systems. Our cutting-edge solutions, including the Bhari Loop-Piezo-Loop-based ATCC System and Camera-based ATCC System, are designed to deliver high accuracy, real-time data, and compliance with the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MORTH) guidelines.

Applications and Benefits

Exelcius Automation’s ATCC systems are widely used for:

  • Traffic Data Collection & Analysis:

    Enhances road planning and infrastructure development.

  • Toll Collection & Audit:

    Ensures accuracy in toll revenue monitoring.

  • Weigh-in-Motion (WIM) Integration:

    Prevents overloading and enhances road safety.

  • Smart City Traffic Management:

    Improves urban mobility and congestion monitoring.

  • Enforcement & Compliance Monitoring:

    Supports vehicle speed monitoring and rule enforcement.

Bhari Loop-Piezo-Loop-Based ATCC System

Our Bhari Loop-Piezo-Loop-based ATCC System integrates advanced inductive loop sensors and piezoelectric sensors to ensure precise vehicle classification and traffic data collection. This system is ideal for national highways, toll plazas, and urban roads, offering the following key features:

Key Components and Features:

1. Inductive Loop Sensors:

  • Installed beneath the road surface to detect vehicle presence and measure vehicle length.

2. Piezoelectric Sensors:

  • Measure axle load and wheel spacing for accurate vehicle classification.

3. High-Speed Data Processing Unit:

  • Ensures real-time vehicle detection and classification.

4. Weatherproof Enclosures:

  • Protects system components from environmental factors.

5. Remote Monitoring & Data Logging:

  • Cloud-based access for seamless data retrieval and analytics.

6. Power Backup & Redundancy:

  • Ensures continuous operation during power outages.

MORTH Compliance:

  • • Adheres to IRC: SP-84 and MORTH Section 900 standards.
  • • Provides 99% accuracy in vehicle classification and count.
  • • Designed to handle multi-lane free-flow traffic with high reliability.

Camera-Based ATCC System

Exelcius Automation also offers a Camera-based ATCC System, leveraging AI-powered video analytics for vehicle detection and classification. This system is suitable for urban roads, smart city projects, and highway management.

Key Components and Features:

  • 1. High-Resolution Cameras: Captures vehicle images and videos with superior clarity.
  • 2. AI & Machine Learning Algorithms: Ensures precise vehicle classification based on shape, size, and movement.
  • 3. Edge Computing for Real-Time Processing: Reduces latency and enhances operational efficiency.
  • 4. Night Vision & IR Sensors: Enables operation in low-light conditions.
  • 5. Seamless Integration with Traffic Management Systems: Compatible with existing ITS infrastructure.
  • 6. Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR): Captures vehicle registration details for enforcement and tolling applications.
  • MORTH Compliance:
  • • Conforms to MORTH and IRC guidelines for camera-based vehicle classification.
  • • Supports multi-lane vehicle detection with 95-98% accuracy.
  • • Complies with Data Security and Storage Regulations to protect sensitive traffic data.

mainEntity.name: What is an ATCC system used for in traffic management?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ATCC (Automatic Traffic Counter and Classifier) system is used to monitor, count, and classify vehicles on highways for traffic analysis, toll management, and infrastructure planning.

mainEntity.name: How does an ATCC system work in highway automation?

acceptedAnswer.text: ATCC systems use sensors and roadside electronics to detect vehicle movement, record traffic data, and send real-time information to control centers for monitoring and decision-making.

mainEntity.name: Where are ATCC systems commonly installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: ATCC systems are commonly installed on highways, expressways, toll plazas, smart city roads, and traffic monitoring infrastructure projects.

mainEntity.name: Can ATCC systems integrate with SCADA or control room software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, ATCC systems can be integrated with SCADA and centralized traffic management systems for real-time monitoring, reporting, and analytics.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of using ATCC systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: ATCC systems improve traffic planning, reduce congestion, provide accurate vehicle classification data, and support intelligent transportation system (ITS) development.

Almost one out of three residential solar systems incurs loss of viable energy daily due to the mismatch of storage capacity, a fact most novice buyers do not find out until they install their systems. A trustworthy Lithium Battery for Solar System enhances evening backup, appliance protection, as well as stabilizes the investment of solar over the years rather than seasons. It is not just about batteries any more. It is regarding the way intelligent storage reinvents all the rays of sunlight gathered.

Lithium Battery for Solar System: Where It Fits Best

A Lithium Battery to power a solar system would be efficient in houses where the evening power demand is high after the sunsets. The families tend to produce a sufficient amount of daytime power but use the majority of it during the office period, hence the need to store the energy. The battery does not drain superfluous power, but rather stores the energy like rainwater in a closed tank.

A Lithium Battery for Solar System is also relied upon in commercial offices to prevent short-term outages that disrupt networking gear and security systems. A three-minute outage is capable of re-initiating servers, disrupting billing systems, and decreasing productivity. The retail space is advantageous as the solar energy that is stored is used in refrigeration, lighting, as well as payment systems when the tariff is at the peak.

Factories are linking a Lithium Battery to Solar System with production scheduling software more and more. It is here that the Industrial Automation Service Providers assist in matching the machine cycles with battery discharge. In the case of cold storage units, the battery should not be able to generate energy abruptly. The irrigation systems in farms also have battery backup on the early morning pumping schedule. A Solar System Lithium Battery enables pumps to operate prior to the appearance of the sun when the demand for water starts.

The reason why lithium storage is preferred by hospitals and diagnostic centres is that voltage consistency ensures that delicate equipment is safeguarded. Even devices that are sensitive to calibration are damaged sooner than most operators feel comfortable with by a fluctuating backup source, which is why Solar Solution Providers tend to suggest modular battery banks in essential sectors. Warehouses with conveyor systems also combine storage with Automation Solutions for Industries to get continuous movement. Once battery systems are in communication with controllers, discharge ceases to be reactive and becomes predictable.

Performance Advantages that Distinguish Lithium and Traditional Storage

Higher usable depth of discharge is the greatest strength of a Lithium Battery to Solar System. In comparison with older types of batteries, lithium units frequently supply between 80 and 90 percent of the energy without serious reduction of lifetime. That implies that additional stored electricity is made available every day rather than being held up as a protected reserve.

A Lithium Battery Solar System also charges quicker, which is important in short winter sunlight. Imagine a bottle with a wide opening rather than a narrow neck. The quicker the energy comes in, the greater the solar production that is captured before sunset.

Another practical benefit is weight. Lithium units have a lower floor load which can benefit rooftop utility rooms and small inverter spaces.

Lithium Ion Battery Manufacturing in India is developing programs of slim wall-mounting on urban installations. This enables less cluttered designs in apartments and offices where space is costly.

A Lithium Battery to Solar System is also better in partial charging compared to normal storage, that is, the intermittent sunlight does not cut long-term efficiency as drastically.

Maintenance is another advantage that is not considered. No one has regular water filling, reduced risk of corrosion, and reduced ventilation issues. Best Companies in automation of industries usually prefer lithium since disruption of maintenance impacts on production planning.

The right battery enhances stability, shields the equipment connected to it, and minimizes energy wasted in the long term. With the assistance of highly skilled partners such as Exelcius Automation, systems are smarter and more responsive in challenging operating environments. Verified solar solution suppliers understand that each installation is unique based on patterns of use and load priorities.

A warehouse, healthcare facility, farmhouse, and apartment building need to be supplied with various storage logic and battery size, this is the reason why the choice of the perfect Lithium Battery in solar system should never be made depending on the theory but the real consumption trends.

Proper planning today prevents unnecessary replacement expenses in the future, costly upgrades, and poor backup performance, the biggest energy systems do not necessarily have the strongest. Cables : Polycab, Finolex and Custom Solutions

Exelcius Automation specializes in providing high-quality cables from renowned brands like Polycab and Finolex as well as custom-manufactured cables tailored to meet specific project requirements. Our cables are designed to cater to a wide range of industrial, infrastructural, and highway applications, offering reliable performance, durability, and compliance with stringent industry standards. With an extensive portfolio and expertise, we have supplied thousands of kilometers of cables to infrastructure and highway projects across the country.

Key Features of Exelcius Automation Cables

  • High Durability:

    Designed to withstand harsh environmental conditions, including high temperatures, moisture, and UV exposure.

  • Excellent Conductivity:

    High-purity copper and aluminum conductors ensure minimal energy loss and superior performance.

  • Flame Retardant Properties:

    FR, FRLS, and LSZH sheathing options reduce fire hazards and ensure safety in critical installations.

  • Long-Length Cables:

    Minimizes joints and reduces installation time and potential points of failure.

  • Versatile Applications:

    Suitable for power, control, data communication, and industrial automation.

Applications Across Sectors

Infrastructure Projects

  • Power distribution for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.

Highways and Toll Systems

  • Power and data cabling for toll plazas, surveillance cameras, and variable message signs (VMS).

mainEntity.name: What types of industrial cables are used in automation systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Industrial automation systems commonly use control cables, power cables, instrumentation cables, Ethernet cables, and shielded communication cables for reliable signal and power transmission.

mainEntity.name: How are industrial cables different from normal electrical cables?

acceptedAnswer.text: Industrial cables are designed for harsh environments with resistance to oil, heat, vibration, and EMI interference, while normal cables are mainly used for household or light commercial applications.

mainEntity.name: Which cables are best for PLC and SCADA systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shielded control cables, Ethernet cables (Cat5e/Cat6), and instrumentation cables are best suited for PLC and SCADA systems due to their high signal integrity and low interference.

mainEntity.name: Can industrial cables be used in outdoor environments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, industrial cables with PVC, PUR or XLPE insulation and proper shielding can be used in outdoor environments where they are exposed to weather, moisture and UV conditions.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide customized cable solutions for automation projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide customized cable solutions based on project requirements including length, shielding type, insulation material and application-specific industrial standards.

title: Different Types of Electric Panels
description: Electric panels are a critical part of electrical systems, facilitating the safe and efficient distribution of power to various loads.
heading: Different Types of Electric Panels
content:
Different Types of Electric Panels

Electric panels are a critical part of electrical systems, facilitating the safe and efficient distribution of power to various loads. Each type of panel is designed to meet specific requirements, whether for residential, commercial, or industrial applications. Understanding the different types of electric panels helps in selecting the right panel for safety, functionality, and efficiency.

1. Main Distribution Panel (MDP)

  • Purpose :

    Serves as the central hub for electrical distribution in a facility.

  • Usage :

    Found in commercial and industrial buildings, factories, and residential complexes.

  • Features :
    • Distributes power to subpanels and branch circuits.
    • Equipped with main circuit breakers and surge protection.
    • Ensures safe energy distribution and overload protection.

2. Sub Distribution Panel (SDP)

  • Purpose :

    Extends power from the main panel to different sections of a building.

  • Usage :

    Used in large buildings, apartments, or factories where power needs to be distributed across multiple locations.

  • Features :
    • Receives power from the MDP and distributes it further.
    • Equipped with individual circuit breakers for safety.
    • Reduces electrical load on the main panel.

3. Motor Control Center (MCC Panel)

  • Purpose :

    Controls and manages electric motors efficiently

  • Usage :

    Found in industries with heavy motor operations like manufacturing, HVAC systems, and water treatment plants.

  • Features :-

    • Houses motor starters, overload relays, and circuit breakers.
    • Allows centralized motor control and protection.
    • Enhances efficiency with automation and remote monitoring options.

4. Power Control Center (PCC Panel)

  • Purpose :

    Controls and manages electrical power distribution.

  • Usage :

    Used in industries such as steel plants, cement plants, and refineries.

  • Features :-
    • Controls the main power distribution.
    • Equipped with high-capacity circuit breakers for protection.
    • Enhances electrical safety and fault tolerance.

5. Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) Panel

  • Purpose :

    Automatically switches to a backup power source in case of main power failure.

  • Usage :

    Used in hospitals, data centers, telecom industries, and buildings with standby generators.

  • Features :-
    • Ensures seamless switching between the main and backup power supply.
    • Helps maintain uninterrupted power supply during outages.
    • Increases electrical reliability for critical operations.

6. Capacitor Panel (Power Factor Correction Panel)

  • Purpose :

    Improves power factor and reduces electricity losses.

  • Usage :

    Found in industries with high inductive loads such as steel mills, paper mills, and foundries.

  • Features :

    • Reduces reactive power loss.
    • Helps in reducing electricity bills by avoiding penalties.
    • Improves the efficiency of electrical systems.

7. Lighting Distribution Board (LDB)

  • Purpose :

    Controls and distributes power to lighting circuits in a facility.

  • Usage :

    Used in homes, commercial buildings, malls, and parking areas.

  • Features :-
    • Ensures separate control of lighting systems.
    • Equipped with individual MCBs (Miniature Circuit Breakers) for protection.
    • Helps in energy-efficient lighting control.

8. AC Distribution Box (ACDB) and DC Distribution Box (DCDB)

  • Purpose :

    Used in solar power plants for proper power distribution.

  • Usage :

    ACDB distributes AC power, while DCDB distributes DC power in solar panel systems.

  • Features :-
    • ACDB protects solar inverters from AC fluctuations.
    • DCDB safeguards against overvoltage and reverse currents in the DC system.
    • Ensures the safety and reliability of solar power plants.

Conclusion

Different types of electric panels play crucial roles in electrical systems, ensuring power distribution, safety, and efficiency across various applications. Whether for residential, commercial, or industrial use, choosing the right type of panel enhances system reliability, prevents electrical hazards, and improves power management.

title: Field Instruments for Industrial Automation | Exelcius Automation
description: Explore high-quality field instruments from Exelcius Automation for accurate measurement and control in industrial automation, ensuring reliable performance and efficiency.
heading: Field Instruments
content:
Field Instruments

At Exelcius Automation, we provide a comprehensive range of Siemens and ABB field instruments designed to deliver precise and reliable measurements for various industrial applications. These field instruments cover critical process parameters such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level, enabling efficient monitoring, control, and optimization of operations. Here’s an in-depth overview of Siemens field instruments, focusing on their capabilities, families, and industry-specific applications.

Siemens Field Instruments

Siemens has been a global leader in process automation, offering a robust portfolio of field instruments. Designed for accuracy, durability, and seamless integration with automation systems, Siemens field instruments are trusted across industries, including oil & gas, water & wastewater, food & beverage, pharmaceuticals, and power generation.

Temperature Measurement Instruments

Siemens temperature measurement devices provide exceptional accuracy and durability, ensuring reliable operation even in extreme conditions.

Key Families and Models

SITRANS TH Series:

  • Compact head-mounted transmitters designed for direct installation with RTDs or thermocouples.

SITRANS TF Series :

  • Rugged transmitters for harsh environments, offering flexible mounting and local display options.

SITRANS TS500 :

  • Modular temperature sensors with customizable configurations to suit diverse industrial needs.

Features

  • Wide measurement range: -200°C to +1200°C.

  • Communication protocols: HART, PROFIBUS, and FOUNDATION Fieldbus.

  • Hazardous area certifications for use in explosive environments

Applications

  • Chemical processing, power plants, food & beverage, and marine systems.

Pressure Measurement Instruments

Siemens pressure instruments offer precise monitoring and control of gauge, differential, and absolute pressure, ensuring safety and efficiency in critical processes.

Key Families and Models:

SITRANS P Series

  • SITRANS P DS III :

    Digital pressure transmitters with high accuracy and diagnostic functions.

  • SITRANS P Compact :

    Compact transmitters for general-purpose applications.

  • SITRANS P500 :

    High-performance transmitters with a focus on extreme precision.

Features :

  • Accuracy levels up to ±0.04%.
  • High overload protection and resistance to harsh environmental conditions.
  • Advanced diagnostics for predictive maintenance.

Applications

  • Oil & gas pipelines, water treatment plants, and power generation facilities.

Flow Measurement Instruments

Siemens flow meters are engineered to provide consistent and accurate flow measurements for liquids, gases, and steam.

Key Families and Models:

SITRANS F Series

  • SITRANS F M MAG Series :

    Electromagnetic flow meters ideal for conductive liquids. (Models: MAG 5000, MAG 6000, MAG 8000).

  • SITRANS F C Coriolis Series :

    High-precision Coriolis flow meters for mass, density, and temperature measurement. (Models: MASS 2100, MASS 6000).

  • SITRANS F X Vortex Flow Meters : Designed for steam, gases, and liquids in utility and process applications.

Features :

  • Multi-parameter measurement capabilities.
  • Maintenance-free designs with minimal pressure drop.
  • Compatibility with HART and other communication protocols.
Applications

  • • Water distribution networks, steam monitoring in power plants, and chemical dosing systems.

Level Measurement Instruments

Siemens offers versatile level measurement solutions, including radar, ultrasonic, guided wave radar, and point level detection technologies, to address diverse industrial challenges.
Key Families and Models:

SITRANS F Series

  • • SITRANS LR Radar Series : Non-contact radar level meters for solids and liquids. (Models: LR100, LR200, LR250).

  • • SITRANS LG Guided Wave Radar : Accurate measurement for interface and level in complex processes.

  • • SITRANS LV and LPS Series : Vibrating and rotary point level switches for critical overfill protection.

Features :

  • • High accuracy for continuous and point level measurements.

  • • Operates effectively in extreme temperature and pressure conditions.

  • • Intelligent diagnostics for predictive maintenance.

Applications

  • • Storage tanks, silos, bulk solids handling, and chemical processing

ABB Field Instruments

ABB offers a comprehensive range of field instruments designed for measurement, monitoring, and control in industrial automation. These instruments ensure precision, reliability, and efficiency across various industries, including oil & gas, chemicals, power, and water treatment.

Types of ABB Field Instruments:

1. Pressure Transmitters

  • • Models : 2600T, 266, 364, 800 Series

  • • Specifications :

    • Measuring ranges from 0-10 mbar to 1000 bar

    • Accuracy up to ±0.025%

    • Communication protocols: HART, PROFIBUS, FOUNDATION Fieldbus

    • Explosion-proof and SIL-rated options

2. Temperature Transmitters

  • • Models : TTF200, TTH300, TSP300

  • • Specifications :

    • Support for RTD, thermocouple, and analog inputs

    • Accuracy up to ±0.05°C

    • Digital and analog output options

    • Wireless and remote sensor capabilities

3. Flow Meters

  • • Types : Electromagnetic, Vortex, Coriolis, Thermal Mass, Ultrasonic

  • • Models : FEP300, FEX100, FSM4000, ProcessMaster, WaterMaster

  • • Specifications :

    • Flow ranges from 0.01 l/h to 10,000 m³/h

    • Accuracy up to ±0.2%

    • IP67/IP68 housing for harsh environments

    • Suitable for conductive and non-conductive fluids

4. Level Measurement Instruments

  • • Types : Ultrasonic, Radar, Guided Wave Radar, Differential Pressure

  • • Models : LLT100, MT5000, LWT300

  • • Specifications :

    • Measuring range up to 100m

    • Accuracy within ±2mm

    • Non-contact and contact technologies

    • Suitable for solids, liquids, and slurries

5. Analytical Instruments

  • • Types : pH, Conductivity, Dissolved Oxygen, Gas Analyzers

  • • Models : AWT420, AC500, Endura, Aztec Series

  • • Specifications :

    • High-precision electrochemical and optical sensors

    • Digital and wireless connectivity

    • Inline process monitoring

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, field instruments can be integrated with PLC and SCADA systems for real-time monitoring, process control, data logging, and industrial automation management.

mainEntity.name: Which industries commonly use field instrumentation systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Field instrumentation systems are widely used in manufacturing plants, oil & gas industries, water treatment facilities, power plants, chemical industries, and process automation applications.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide installation and calibration support for field instruments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide installation, calibration, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance support for industrial field instruments and automation systems.

What is Highway Electrical Automation?

Highway electrical automation is the application of automated electrical systems and smart control technologies to control several highway functions. These consist of road lighting, traffic lights, tunnel systems, surveillance cameras, variable message signs and emergency response systems.

Professional Highway Electrical Automation Service Providers design and implement built-in solutions, which enable centralized control, real-time monitoring, and quicker reaction to incidents. Highway Electrical Automation Service Providers deal with end-to-end implementation, which provides the smooth integration of electrical and digital environments. They are involved in system design, electrical integration, automation programming, testing, and long-term maintenance.

These providers achieve this through the deployment of intelligent systems that enable highway authorities to promote traffic flow, reduce accidents, and maintain continuous operations despite high traffic or other adverse conditions.

How Highway Electrical Automation Service Providers Work

  • System Design:

  • Electrical Integration:

The experienced Highway Electrical Automation Services Providers are going to make sure that every performance stage is optimized to perform well in terms of longevity and reliability.

Uses of Highway Electrical Automation

Highway Electrical Automation Service Providers use these applications to increase the safety and efficiency of highway networks.

Qualities of Highway Electrical Automation Service Providers

An excellent Highway Electrical Automation Service Providers should possess the technical skills and experience in developing, implementing, and maintaining intelligent highway systems. They ought to know how to combine lighting, traffic lights, surveillance, and control systems to enable efficient, safe, and smooth highway operations. Also, the leading service providers are concerned with safety, compliance,e and long-term support. Good project management, problem-solving, and the capacity to propose scalable solutions that may be used in case of further highway expansions are other highly valued attributes that make a provider shine in the sector.

Why Choose Exelcius Automation?

Exelcius Automation is known to provide high-quality and advanced highway automation solutions. Highway automation is no longer a choice, a necessity to create safe, efficient, and smart road networks. Instant Process Awareness

Operators gain a clear, real-time view of system status and process health, enabling faster situational understanding and more confident decision-making.

EAPL
Solution

Remote Control and Accessibility

Exelcius HMIs allow users to adjust parameters, manage workflows, and interact with automation systems remotely—supporting flexible operations and reducing response times.

Proactive Alarm Management

Visual alarm notifications ensure that operators can respond promptly to system events, helping prevent downtime and maintain production integrity.

By integrating intelligent visualization with secure connectivity, Exelcius HMI solutions support your journey from operator-driven systems to increasingly autonomous, data-empowered operations—all while strengthening performance, productivity, and reliability across your plant.

Why a Modern HMI Solution?

Collaborative Design

Streamline the design process through multi-user collaboration, web-based design in the cloud with IT-style workflows and version control.

Real-time Data Visualization

Give operators and maintenance an intuitive experience that lowers the learning curve and makes them effective in managing the process for maximum uptime.

Comprehensive Data

Our Main Leading Services

PCC and MCC Control Panel

A PCC (Power Control Center) panel distributes and controls electrical power in industrial and commercial applications, while an MCC (Motor Control Center) panel manages multiple motors, ensuring efficient operation, monitoring, and protection.

VFD Control Panel

VFD control panels are mainly used to control the speed of the electric motors and also of the feed pumps that are used in various industrial facilities. Every motor has varying frequency and voltage.

APFC Control Panel

Automatic Power factor correction panel is fully automatic in operation and can achieve desired power factor under fluctuating load conditions

Power Distribution Panel

This type of panel distributes and controls power supply to multiple circuits, ensuring safe and efficient electricity distribution in buildings or industrial setups.

Roadside Panel Cabinets

We manufacture all types of Roadside panel cabinets like Toll Lane Controller (TLC), Automatic traffic counter & classifier (ATCC), Video incident detection system (VIDS), Variable Message Sign (VMS), PTZ Camera, Vehicle actuated speed display (VASD) etc.

Energy Metering System

An Energy Metering System is used to measure, monitor, and analyse electrical energy consumption in industrial, commercial, and residential applications. It helps in energy management, cost optimization, and power quality analysis.

PLC/HMI/SCADA

PLC, HMI and SCADA are the main components of the industrial automation. Together, they form a complete industrial automation system, improving efficiency, monitoring, and control in various industries like manufacturing, power, and infrastructure.

Field Instrumentation

The diligent demands of process operations require to have reliable, accurate devices that gives the measurements to meet the user’s requirements.

RFID Based Tracing & Tracking Solutions

The ability to track and trace complete information at item level in an efficient and trustworthy manner is becoming more and more important for companies,

System Integration

System integration is essential to reap the benefits of big data, IoT, and digital transformation. However, with all your different data silos and specialized systems, integration is not an easy business.

Alarm Management

Implementation of a successful alarm management program can seem complex in the beginning. Knowing where and how to start can be a daunting experience.

Sensors, IOT Solutions

Sensors and IoT work together to create smart systems by detecting physical changes and transmitting real-time data over the internet. Sensors collect data, while IoT enables connectivity, remote monitoring, and intelligent decision-making.

Our Trusted Partners

Why to Choose Exelcius Automation

Innovative Engineering

We seamlessly integrate cutting-edge technologies with industry best practices to deliver solutions that exceed expectations.

Expert Team

Our team of highly skilled professionals specializes in mechanics, electricity, automation, instrumentation, and information systems.

Proven Experience

With over 3000+ panels, 2000+ poles, and 8000+ brackets successfully delivered, our track record speaks for itself.

Quality and Reliability

Partnering with globally recognized brands such as Siemens, ABB, Allen Bradley, Schneider, Omron, Eaton & PROCON, we ensure the highest standards of quality & performance.

heading: Industrial Automation Service Providers: Driving Smart Industry Growth
content:
Industrial Automation Service Providers: Driving Smart Industry Growth

In the industrial sector today, companies innovate processes to work more efficiently, cost-effectively, and homogeneously. Industrial automation service providers help improve productivity without the need for human intervention. With the help of automation, companies can integrate advanced technologies to achieve the benefits of modern technologies without the labor cost.

Automation has become more democratized as more enterprises turn to automation services. Because of the increasing demand for efficiency, speed, and the ability to self-scale, companies must select industrial automation services carefully in order to continue growing.

What Are Industrial Automation Services?

Services automated using advanced Industrial Automation Systems such as PLCs, SCADA, robotics and IoT based monitoring systems. These industrial automation systems are created by specialist industrial automation service providers and are used to improve operational efficacies by simplifying complicated processes.

The aim of the automation process is to reduce the amount of manual work and error, and maintain the pp continuum of the productivity. These systems encompass the entire spectrum of performance, from plant automation to machine level control.

Key Services Offered by Industrial Automation Service Providers

The main services offered by top industrial automation services include:

  • Integration of PLC programming and control systems
  • SCADA systems and their monitoring
  • The design and build of industrial control systems
  • Automation of control and industrial processes and machinery
  • Automation of electric systems
  • Service and annual maintenance contracts

These services enable industries to perform more effectively and increase productivity by minimizing downtime.

Benefits of Industrial Automation

Long-term benefits of engaging with professional industrial automation skill providers include:

Improved Efficiency

Faster production automation reduces the need for manual work.

Financial Savings:

It reduces labor costs and helps utilize resources effectively over time.

Superior Safety:

Automation reduces the need for human labor in dangerous work environments.

Improved Uniformity of Quality

Automation can result in greater quality improvement.

Continuous Quality:

Precise. Robust. Accurate. Quality improvement is assured.

Instant Quality:

Real-time. Firms can eternalize improvement.

What Defines a Good Automation Company?

Quality service can vary from one industrial automation company to another company. What separates automation company from the rest is the focus on innovation, customization, and long term support. A few more notable qualities are:

  • Extensive industry knowledge and technical skills
  • Capability to provide tailored systems and services
  • Incorporation of modern and advanced technology
  • Completion of projects within the agreed upon timelines
  • Dependable after sales support

Newer companies in the market, such as Exelcius Automation, have begun to stand out and offer practical and efficient automation services to a variety of automation needs. These companies provide value services, not one-size-fits all solutions.

Industries That Use Automation Services

Automation services touch numerous sectors, and industrial automation service providers work across sectors like:

  • Manufacturing and production
  • Pharma and healthcare
  • Food and beverage
  • Oil and gas
  • Energy and utilities
  • Automotive and heavy engineering

Every sector has its own needs, and automation solutions are custom tailored to design utilities for better efficiency and output.

How to Choose the Right Industrial Automation Service Providers

The choice of industrial automation service providers has a long-term impact and should be carefully evaluated. The following factors matter when selecting a service:

  • Look at what they’ve done and the clients they’ve worked for.
  • Consider their feedback and what their clients have said.
  • Assess their tech savvy.
  • Quality service requires customization.
  • Explore the maintenance and support.

With the right services tailored for their automation goals and growing client satisfaction, customers can expect great services.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What do industrial automation service providers do?

Ans Automation system services for industrial settings include PLC, SCADA, and robotics services.

2. Why is industrial automation important?

Ans Having industrial automation systems implemented saves time, money, reduces risk, and increases product reliability and accuracy.

3. Which industries use industrial automation services?

Ans Automation is employed in manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, food processing, automotive, and energy sectors industries.

4. Is automation suitable for small businesses?

Ans Definitely. Automation is scalable, making systems more affordable in the long-term.

5. How to choose the best industrial automation service providers?

Ans Your automation service provider should be well established, specialize in bespoke systems to the users, and offer quality support and innovative tech.

Conclusion

As industries evolve toward more efficient and high tech operations, industrial automation service providers are shouldering increasing demand. Automation services improve productivity, process safety, and assure outcomes minimize human error. Selecting an ideal service firm allows companies obtain sustained, prosperous-long enterprise operations within a world that's constantly changing and unpredictably evolving.

heading:
Joint Enclosures and Fiber Splice Closures (CommScope
                                            Make)
content:
Joint Enclosures and Fiber Splice Closures (CommScope Make)

Exelcius Automation is a trusted provider of high-quality Joint Enclosures and Fiber Optic Splice Closures (FOSC) designed for seamless and reliable fiber jointing in critical infrastructure projects. Our offerings include the industry-renowned CommScope FOSC-400 series, which is widely recognized for its robustness, ease of installation, and exceptional performance in fiber optic networks. These products, commonly referred to as "Tiffin Boxes" for fiber joints, are engineered to protect and manage fiber splices, ensuring the integrity of optical signals in various environments.

Product Overview

The CommScope Fiber Optic Splice Closure (FOSC-400) series and other joint enclosures supplied by Exelcius Automation are designed to safeguard fiber optic splices from environmental and mechanical stresses. These enclosures are suitable for both aerial and underground installations, making them an ideal choice for highway, telecom, and industrial projects.

Key Features

1. Durable Construction

  • Made from high-strength plastic or thermoplastic material to resist corrosion, UV rays, and mechanical impact.
  • Waterproof and dustproof design ensures long-term reliability.

2. Versatile Compatibility

  • Compatible with various types of optical cables, including loose tube, ribbon, and central core cables.
  • Designed to accommodate single-mode and multi-mode fibers

3. Ample Splice Capacity

  • Supports multiple splice trays, providing high splice capacity to meet large-scale project requirements.
  • Each tray can typically hold up to 24 or more splices, depending on the model.

4. Easy Installation and Maintenance

  • Tool-free closure design with reusable seal technology.
  • Hinged trays and integrated routing guides for efficient fiber management.

5. Weatherproof Design

  • IP68-rated for resistance to water ingress
  • Suitable for extreme weather conditions, including high humidity, heavy rain, and temperature fluctuations.

Specifications

1. CommScope FOSC-400 Series

  • Material :

    High-performance thermoplastic.

  • Capacity :

    Up to 96 fiber splices (expandable with additional trays).

  • Sealing :

    Mechanical or heat-shrink seals for secure protection.

  • Ease of Installation :

    Pre-drilled holes, modular designs, and flexible mounting options ensure quick and secure installation.

  • Ports :

    Multiple cable entry ports to support diverse network topologies.

2. Accessories

  • Cable gland kits, mounting brackets, and splice protection sleeves.
  • Integrated organizer for fiber storage and bend radius control.

Applications

Exelcius Automation's Joint Enclosures and Fiber Optic Splice Closures are ideal for:

  • Highway Infrastructure :

    Protecting and managing fiber optic connections for Intelligent Traffic Management Systems (ITMS).

  • Telecommunication Networks :

    Ensuring stable and reliable connections in long-distance and metropolitan networks.

  • Industrial Facilities :

    Safeguarding fiber connections in harsh environments, including chemical plants and factories.

  • FTTH (Fiber to the Home) :

    Managing fiber connections in residential and commercial broadband networks.

description: Explore high-quality Lightning Arresters from Exelcius Automation designed to protect electrical systems from surge and lightning damage. Reliable and durable solutions.
heading: Lightning Arresters (SG Power Make)
content:
Lightning Arresters (SG Power Make)

Exelcius Automation takes pride in providing high-quality Lightning Arresters tailored to meet customer-specific requirements. Our lightning arresters, manufactured by SG Power, are designed to deliver optimal protection against lightning strikes and transient voltage surges, ensuring the safety and longevity of electrical systems in critical highway infrastructure projects.

Product Overview

Our lightning arresters are crafted from pure copper, offering superior conductivity, durability, and resistance to environmental factors. These arresters are ideal for use in various highway applications, where robust protection against electrical surges is essential. Exelcius Automation supplies a complete solution, including all necessary accessories, ensuring hassle-free installation and seamless integration into existing systems.

Key Features

High-Quality Material

  • Pure copper construction ensures excellent conductivity and corrosion resistance.

  • Long-lasting performance in harsh environmental conditions.

Tailored Solutions

  • Customizable designs to meet specific project requirements.

  • Suitable for diverse installations, including pole-mounted, gantry-mounted, and ground-mounted setups.

Complete Accessory Kit

  • Includes mounting brackets, clamps, earthing conductors, surge counters, and insulators.

  • Simplifies installation and reduces downtime during setup.

Standards and Certifications

  • Compliant with IEC 60099-4 and IS 15086 standards

  • Tested and approved for high reliability and performance in severe lightning conditions.

Specifications

Voltage Ratings:

  • Available for systems ranging from 11 kV to 220 kV.

Current Ratings :

  • Discharge capacities ranging from 10 kA to 20 kA.

Material

  • Body: Pure copper rods and strips

  • Insulation: Weatherproof and UV-resistant polymer housings.

Accessories

  • Copper earthing kits
  • High-tensile mounting clamps
  • Lightning surge counters with real-time monitoring capabilities

Design

  • Compact and lightweight for ease of transportation and installation.
  • Designed to withstand high wind speeds, rain, and temperature fluctuations.

Applications

Exelcius Automation’s lightning arresters are extensively used in:

  • Highway and Road Infrastructure Projects:
    Protecting toll plazas, lighting systems, and roadside equipment.

  • Telecommunication Systems :
    Shielding communication towers and systems from surges.

  • Solar and Renewable Energy Systems :
    Safeguarding panels, inverters, and other critical components.

  • Industrial and Commercial Buildings :
    Providing surge protection for substations and control panels.

content:
High Performance Lithium Battery for Solar System

The need for clean and trusted energy solutions is on the rise as solar energy is found to be the alternative of choice between residential buildings and organizations. Effective energy storage is crucial in the provision of uninterrupted power and the fullest investment in solar energy. A Lithium Battery for Solar System allows the user to maintain the additional solar power produced throughout the day and utilize it at any time, even at night or during a power outage. These batteries have enhanced efficiency, longevity, and reliability with the highly developed technology. At Exelcius Automation, the products are high-performance energy storage solutions to facilitate modern solar applications with greater safety, stability, and a reliable power supply.

What is a Lithium Battery for Solar System?

A Lithium Battery for Solar System is a high-end energy storage device that is designed with the express purpose of storing the electric power produced by solar panels throughout the day and using it when sunlight is not available. As opposed to conventional batteries, lithium-based systems are designed using the current cell technology, which is more energy-dense, charges faster, and has an extended working duration.

They are popularly employed in residential rooftops, commercial solar systems, and off-grid products due to the efficient energy use of these batteries. They are compact, lightweight, with intelligent battery management systems that enable the user to check the performance and ensure consistent power output.

Uses of Lithium Battery for Solar System

Residential Solar power storage

Solar storage can be used by homeowners to store energy received during the day to be used at night. This assists in limiting the reliance on grid power and reduces the costs of power monthly.

Commercial and Industrial Applications

Companies need constant power to conduct their activities. The Lithium solar storage can provide consistent backup power, which does not impose downtime in case of an outage.

Off-Grid Solar Installs

Areas that are not connected to the grid are far away and therefore dependent on solar energy stored. The electric power is provided without interruption owing to a reliable storage system.

Key Highlights of Lithium Battery for Solar System

  • Minimization of power loss and a high energy efficiency.
  • Quick charging as opposed to traditional batteries
  • Small in size and space-saving design
  • Increased working life
  • High safety protection measures
  • Constant and steady power delivery.
  • Poor maintenance needs.
  • Intelligent energy and surveillance.

These characteristics render Lithium Battery for Solar System of modern times appropriate to the small and large-scale energy requirements.

Advantages of Lithium Battery for Solar System

High Energy Density

The Lithium technology concentrates more energy in a small area, and thus, the installation is compact and efficient. The users also enjoy increased storage space without having to carry huge battery banks.

Longer Life Cycle

Lithium batteries have thousands of charge cycles as opposed to the traditional storage options. This durability minimizes the replacement rate and the total cost of operation.

Faster Charging Capability

High-performance batteries are fast and can be charged with the help of solar energy, so that the maximum storage can be achieved during the short sunlight ranges.

Why Choose Exelcius Automation?

Exelcius Automation is involved in providing effective and consistent solar energy solutions in accordance with the contemporary energy needs. Innovation, quality engineering, and long-term performance are stressed to make sure that customers are provided with reliable storage systems to be used in residential and commercial solar purposes.

Maintaining high energy consumption and a high level of integration with the latest technologies, the solutions focus on the maximization of solar power usage without jeopardizing the safety and durability. The professional assistance and system design allow users to attain energy independence on a constant basis.

Conclusion

The use of solar energy has been on the increase as more individuals and organizations look towards the use of power that is sustainable. Solar installations require efficient technology in their storage to maximize their benefits. A Lithium Battery for Solar System would be a high-performance battery, which would guarantee successful power storage, efficiency, and continuous power.

With the application of an advanced battery technology along with the intelligent management of energy, users can gain improved energy self-sufficiency and lower electric bills. The solutions provided by Exelcius Automation provide an advantage to the contemporary solar infrastructure, as they provide durability, safety, and reliable functioning, which makes them the best solution in terms of a long-term investment in renewable energy.

heading: Lithium Ion Battery Manufacturers in India for Power Backup
content:
Lithium Ion Battery Manufacturers in India for Power Backup

The global modernized world has faced the need to have a dependable power backup system in homes, businesses, and industries. That is where Lithium Ion Battery Manufacturers in India of Power Backup are very important in providing efficient and long-term energy solutions. As the technological world is developing with incredible speed, the Lithium Ion Battery has become the favorite as it provides high energy density, the possibility to charge in a short period of time, and the possibility to work longer than the traditional battery.

India is also experiencing a boost in the demand for sustainable and reliable power backup systems, and this is pushing manufacturers to be creative and meet the demands with high quality of battery solutions. These batteries are available in residential applications to large-scale industrial usage, where power is needed even when the system is under outage.

Definition of Lithium Ion Battery

Lithium Ion Battery are rechargeable energy storage systems, which make use of lithium ions to move between the anode and cathode in charging and discharging. The characteristics of these batteries include high energy density, lightweight, and long life cycle.

Compared to conventional batteries, the lithium-ion technology has quicker charging, low maintenance, and increased efficiency. This has made a lot of Lithium Ion Battery Manufacturers in India concentrate on the innovations of superior battery mechanisms to satisfy the growing power needs in different sectors.

They have the capability to take up vast quantities of energy in a small size, making them suitable for small-scale as well as large-scale applications.

How Lithium Ion Battery Works

A Lithium Ion Battery produces power by a simple and efficient chemical reaction. It is comprised of two broad electrodes, an anode and a cathode, with an electrolyte in between. During the usage of the battery, the lithium ions flow out of the anode and into the cathode, producing a flow of electrons through an external circuit that generates electricity. This is reversed during the charging process, and the ions are returned to the anode in order to be stored. This constant flow of ions enables the battery to charge and discharge on numerous occasions and with great efficiency. This mechanism makes lithium-ion batteries have a quick charge, constant operation, and prolonged power supply, and as such, they are perfect for the contemporary energy and backup energy requirements.

Uses of Lithium Ion Battery

Lithium Ion Battery have been employed in many sectors, owing to their diverse usage and efficiency. The large applications are:

  • Solar Energy Storage

    These batteries are used to store the energy produced by solar panels to be used later on to keep power flowing continuously.

  • Electric Vehicles (EVs)

    EVs are the foundation of EV technology, which offer efficient and extended power.

  • Industrial Applications

    These batteries are used in factories and manufacturing plants for backup and efficiency.

  • Home Backup Systems

    Houses have batteries of lithium-ion that provide power when there is a blackout.

  • Telecommunication Systems

    These batteries maintain the constant functioning of the communication networks.

As the trend towards renewable energy is on the rise, Lithium Ion Battery Manufacturers in India are becoming instrumental in providing the energy for sustainability solutions.

Top Reasons to Choose Lithium Ion Battery

Selection of the appropriate battery provider is critical to performance in the long-term. The following are the main highlights:

  • High Energy Efficiency

    Produces the optimum output with the least energy waste.

  • Long Lifespan

    Designed for years of performance with consistent performance.

  • Compact Design

    The design is space-saving and can be installed flexibly.

  • Low Maintenance

    Makes low maintenance as compared to traditional batteries.

  • Quick Charging Option

    Lessens time loss and boosts efficiency.

Exelcius Automation also makes its battery systems up to the maximum standards, hence the choice is reliable among the Lithium Ion Battery Manufacturers in India.

The benefits of Lithium Ion Battery

High Energy Density

heading: Loop Detectors for Vehicle Detection
content:
Loop Detectors for Vehicle Detection

Exelcius Automation specializes in providing high-quality Loop Detectors, such as the Procon Loop Detector LD202 Dual Channel, designed for precision vehicle detection and traffic management systems. Our range of loop detectors is engineered for robust performance, reliability, and integration with modern intelligent traffic solutions. These detectors are widely used in highways, parking systems, toll plazas, and industrial automation applications.

Product Overview

Loop detectors function as essential components in vehicle detection systems by sensing the presence and movement of vehicles passing over an inductive loop installed in the ground. The Procon LD202 Dual Channel Loop Detector is a state-of-the-art solution that offers superior accuracy and operational efficiency for various traffic and access control applications.

Key Features of Procon LD202 Dual Channel

1. Dual-Channel Detection

  • Simultaneous monitoring of two independent loops for enhanced coverage and precision
  • Ideal for complex traffic flow scenarios such as multi-lane tolls or parking exits.

2. Wide Operating Voltage

  • Operates efficiently within a range of 11–26 VAC/DC at 50/60 Hz.
  • Maximum power consumption: 95mA, ensuring energy efficiency.

3. Compact and Durable Design

  • Built to withstand harsh environments with robust housing and high-temperature tolerance.
  • Compact form factor for easy installation in confined spaces.

4. Adjustable Sensitivity

  • Multiple sensitivity levels to accommodate varying vehicle sizes and loop configurations.
  • Sensitivity settings ensure optimal performance in diverse applications

5. Fast Response Time

  • Quick detection and response to ensure real-time vehicle management.
  • Reliable performance even under heavy traffic conditions.

6. Self-Tuning Functionality

  • Automatically adjusts to the connected inductive loop, reducing the need for manual configuration.
  • Eliminates interference from nearby electrical systems for consistent accuracy.

7. Fail-Safe Design

  • Ensures continuous operation by providing fail-safe detection in case of system anomalies.
Parameter Specification
Model Procon LD202 Dual Channel
Power Supply 11–26 VAC/DC, 50/60 Hz
Power Consumption 95mA maximum
Channels Dual
Frequency Adjustable in multiple ranges to avoid crosstalk
Response Time <120 milliseconds
Housing Material ABS/Polycarbonate, durable and weatherproof
Operating Temperature -20°C to +70°C
Loop Inductance Range 20µH to 1000µH

Applications

  • Toll Collection Systems :

    Accurate detection of vehicles at toll gates, ensuring seamless flow and reducing waiting times.

  • Parking Management :

    Used in parking entry/exit systems to monitor vehicle movement and automate barrier controls.

  • Traffic Management Systems :

    Implemented in Intelligent Traffic Management Systems (ITMS) for signal control and congestion management.

  • Industrial Automation :

    Utilized in automated gates, loading docks, and factory entrances for vehicle control and safety.

  • Access Control :

    Ensures secure and efficient access to restricted areas by detecting and authorizing vehicles.

heading: Pcc And Mcc Panel
content:
Power Control Centers (PCC)

Power Control Centers (PCC) are the backbone of efficient electrical power distribution in large facilities, ensuring reliable and safe operation. Designed with advanced protection mechanisms and intuitive control options, Exelcius Automation’s PCC panels are engineered to handle the complexities of modern industrial and infrastructure applications.

Key Features of PCC Panels :

  • • Enhanced Power Distribution : Our PCC panels facilitate the seamless flow of electricity to various systems and equipment, preventing downtime and optimizing operational efficiency.

  • • Advanced Protection Mechanisms : Equipped with cutting-edge safety features like overload protection, short circuit prevention, and fault isolation, our panels safeguard your equipment and workforce.

  • • User-Friendly Controls :Intuitive controls allow easy monitoring and management, ensuring maximum system productivity.

  • • Customizable Configurations :Tailored to meet the specific needs of your facility, our PCC panels incorporate high-quality switchgear and components from trusted global brands like Siemens and Schneider Electric.

Applications :

  • • Large manufacturing facilities

  • • Power plants

  • • Infrastructure projects like tunnels and highways

Benefits

  • • Improved energy management

  • • Reduced operational risks

  • • Long-term reliability and cost efficiency

Motor Control Centers (MCC)

Motor Control Centers (MCC) are vital for the efficient and reliable control of electric motors across various industrial operations. Exelcius Automation’s MCC panels are built with precision engineering to ensure optimal motor performance and protection.

Key Features of MCC Panels :

  • • Versatile Configurations : Whether your application requires direct-on-line (DOL) starters, star-delta configurations, or soft starters, our MCC panels offer a solution for every need.

  • • Comprehensive Motor Protection : Equipped with advanced overload relays and circuit breakers, our MCC panels protect motors from electrical faults, enhancing their lifespan.

  • • Scalability :Modular designs ensure that the panels can be expanded to accommodate future motor additions, making them suitable for growing facilities.

  • • Easy Maintenance :Neatly arranged wiring and labeling facilitate quick troubleshooting and minimize downtime.

Applications :

  • • Sugar industry for motor-driven equipment

  • • Agrochemical plants for process automation

  • • Food and beverage industries for packaging and conveyor systems

Benefits

  • • Reduced energy consumption with efficient motor control

  • • Increased operational safety and reliability

  • • Custom-built panels to match specific industrial needs

Why Choose Exelcius Automation?

Exelcius Automation combines cutting-edge technology, skilled craftsmanship, and customer-centric design to deliver electrical panels that power industries efficiently and reliably.

  • • Advanced Manufacturing Capabilities : From laser cutting to powder coating, our in-house facilities enable us to deliver superior quality panels with unmatched precision.

  • • Custom Solutions : Every panel is tailored to meet your exact requirements, incorporating the switchgear and components of your choice.

  • • Industry Expertise : Our experience spans multiple sectors, giving us a deep understanding of industry-specific challenges and needs.

  • • Quality Assurance : With stringent quality control measures at every stage, we ensure that our panels exceed your expectations.

  • • End-to-End Services : From design and manufacturing to installation and after-sales support, we provide a complete solution under one roof.

By combining high-quality materials, cutting-edge technology, and decades of industry expertise, Exelcius Automation delivers PCC and MCC panels that meet and exceed the demands of today’s industrial landscape.

mainEntity.name: What are industrial power supplies used for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Industrial power supplies are used to convert and regulate electrical power for automation systems, PLC panels, SCADA systems, sensors and other industrial control equipment.

mainEntity.name: What types of power supplies does Exelcius Automation offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exelcius Automation offers Switched Mode Power Supplies (SMPS), regulated DC power supplies and industrial-grade power modules for automation and infrastructure applications.

mainEntity.name: Why are SMPS power supplies preferred in automation systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: SMPS power supplies are preferred because they offer high efficiency, compact size, low heat generation and stable output voltage required for PLC, HMI and SCADA systems.

mainEntity.name: Can industrial power supplies be used for PLC and SCADA panels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, industrial power supplies are essential for PLC and SCADA panels as they provide stable DC voltage to ensure uninterrupted automation and control system operation.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide installation and replacement of industrial power supplies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide installation, replacement, troubleshooting and maintenance support for industrial power supply systems used in automation and infrastructure projects.

title: Precautionary Guidelines for Electrical HT/LT PanelsE
description: High Tension (HT) and Low Tension (LT) panels are critical components in electrical power systems and protecting electrical energy in industrial
heading: Precautionary Guidelines for Electrical HT/LT Panels
content:
Precautionary Guidelines for Electrical HT/LT Panels

High Tension (HT) and Low Tension (LT) panels are critical components in electrical power systems, responsible for managing, distributing, and protecting electrical energy in industrial, commercial, and utility applications. Proper safety measures and regular maintenance are essential to ensure the reliability, efficiency, and longevity of these panels. This guide highlights key precautionary guidelines to minimize risks, prevent electrical failures, and maintain a safe working environment.

Understanding HT and LT Panels

  • HT (High Tension) Panels: Operate at voltage levels above 11 kV and are used in substations, power generation units, and heavy industries.
  • LT (Low Tension) Panels: Operate at voltages up to 1 kV and are used in industrial plants, commercial buildings, and residential complexes for power distribution.

General Safety Precautions for HT/LT Panels

1. Personnel Safety Measures

      • Only trained and authorized personnel should operate or perform maintenance on electrical panels.
      • Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) such as insulated gloves, safety shoes, arc flash suits, and face shields.
      • Ensure proper isolation of power supply before working on panels. Use lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures.
      • Keep a safe distance while operating HT panels to prevent electrical arc exposure.

      2. Installation & Panel Placement Guidelines

      • Install panels in well-ventilated, dry, and dust-free locations to prevent overheating and moisture accumulation.
      • Maintain a minimum clearance space around HT/LT panels for easy maintenance and emergency access.
      • Use proper earthing and bonding techniques to prevent stray voltage and electrical shocks.

      3. Fire & Explosion Prevention

      • Use fire-retardant panel enclosures to minimize fire risks in case of short circuits.
      • Keep fire extinguishers, such as CO₂ or dry powder, near electrical panels.
      • Ensure cable terminations are tight to prevent loose connections that may lead to overheating.

      4. Protection Against Overvoltage & Overload

      • Install surge protection devices (SPDs) to protect against sudden voltage spikes.
      • Ensure panels are equipped with circuit breakers (MCB/MCCB/VCB/Air Circuit Breakers) to prevent overload damage.
      • Conduct periodic insulation resistance tests to check cable and equipment insulation quality.

      5. Precautions Specific to HT Panels

      • Ensure proper earthing connections to prevent grounding failures.
      • Do not operate HT panels with wet hands or in damp conditions to avoid electric shocks.
      • Verify the tightness of busbar joints and terminations to prevent excessive temperature rise.
      • Keep the HT panel doors closed and interlocked to avoid accidental contact with live parts.

      6. Precautions Specific to LT Panels

      • Ensure all fuses, breakers, and switches are in working condition.
      • Label all panel circuits correctly for quick identification during maintenance.
      • Use cable glands and sealing techniques to prevent dust and insects from entering the panel.
      • Ensure balanced load distribution across different panel circuits to avoid overloading any single phase.
      • Replace damaged cables, relays, and contactors immediately to prevent system failures.

      Conclusion

      Adhering to precautionary guidelines for HT/LT panels is crucial to ensuring safety, preventing costly equipment failures, and enhancing the reliability of electrical power distribution. Routine maintenance, proper operation procedures, and emergency preparedness help create a safe working environment, reducing risks associated with electrical hazards.

      By implementing these precautions, industries can improve operational efficiency, minimize downtime, and protect personnel from potential electrical dangers.

description: High-performance SCADA systems for monitoring, control and data acquisition across industrial automation and electrical applications.
heading: SCADA Solutions
content:
SCADA Solutions

At Exelcius Automation, we deliver powerful industrial software solutions powered by FactoryTalk to create a connected and intelligent manufacturing environment. Designed to support modern industrial ecosystems, FactoryTalk® enables seamless integration of advanced applications, including Industrial IoT, helping organizations move towards smarter and more data-driven operations.

Our solutions start at the manufacturing edge, where real-time production data is generated, and scale effortlessly from on-premise systems to cloud-based platforms. With advanced design tools, improved operational visibility, and predictive maintenance capabilities, we help industries enhance efficiency, reliability, and overall plant performance.

Whether it is process, batch, or discrete manufacturing, Exelcius Automation combines industry-leading technology, expertise, and services to solve complex automation challenges and deliver scalable, future-ready solutions for modern industries.

Studio 5000 View Designer
Machine Level HMI on PanelView 5000
  • Premier integration with ControlLogix + I/O high-speed jog
  • Design-time software included with Studio 5000
  • Automatic Diagnostics and Logix alarming
FactoryTalk® View ME
Machine Level HMI on PanelView Plus
  • Support for ControlLogix and 3rd party controllers via Kepware
  • Common design-time across PanelView Plus products
  • Hardware options for different environments
FactoryTalk® View SE
Scalable HMI on IPC
  • PlantPAx Modern DCS
  • Single-station to fully distributed systems
  • Support for ControlLogix and third-party controllers
FactoryTalk® Optix™
Scalable HMI on OptixPanel or IPC
  • Cloud-enabled through FactoryTalk Hub
  • MQTT connectivity
  • OPC UA interoperability
  • Web clients and device management

Rockwell Automation (Allen Bradley) SCADA Solutions by Exelcius Automation

Rockwell Automation’s FactoryTalk SCADA Suite offers high-performance industrial automation software designed for various applications, from machine-level control to enterprise-wide system monitoring. Exelcius Automation specializes in integrating Rockwell SCADA solutions with robust PLC hardware, industrial networks, and control systems, ensuring a seamless, intelligent automation framework.

1. FactoryTalk View SE – Large-Scale Distributed SCADA

FactoryTalk View SE (Site Edition) is a comprehensive SCADA platform designed for distributed industrial environments. It enables multi-site monitoring, advanced process control, and enterprise-level automation. Exelcius Automation integrates FactoryTalk View SE with Allen-Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix PLCs, ensuring real-time data acquisition and secure remote control.

Key Features:
  • ✔ Client-Server Architecture– Supports distributed control systems.
  • ✔ High-Performance Graphics & Real-Time Monitoring – Interactive displays for process visualization.
  • ✔ Advanced Alarm & Event Handling – Instant alerts for critical conditions.
  • ✔ Secure Multi-User Access – Role-based authentication and cybersecurity features
  • ✔ Web-Based Access with FactoryTalk ViewPoint – Remote access to SCADA screens.
  • 2. FactoryTalk View ME – Machine-Level SCADA & HMI Solution

    FactoryTalk View ME (Machine Edition) is a compact SCADA/HMI solution designed for standalone machine-level control. It is commonly deployed with Allen-Bradley PanelView Plus HMIs, making it perfect for localized automation with real-time visualization.

    Key Features:
  • ✔ Standalone or Embedded SCADA – Runs on PanelView Plus terminals.
  • ✔ Touchscreen-Based HMI Interface – Intuitive control for operators.
  • ✔Integrated Alarm & Historical Data Logging – Advanced diagnostics.
  • ✔ Direct Communication with Allen-Bradley PLCs – Seamless integration.
  • ✔ Ethernet & Serial Network Support – Multiple connectivity options.
  • 3. FactoryTalk VantagePoint EMI – Enterprise SCADA Analytics

    FactoryTalk VantagePoint EMI (Enterprise Manufacturing Intelligence) is an advanced SCADA analytics platform that provides real-time performance tracking, KPI reporting, and production insights. It enables enterprise-wide data visualization.

    Key Features:
  • ✔ Advanced Reporting & Dashboards– SQL-based data management.
  • ✔ Historical & Real-Time Data Visualization – Trend analysis.
  • ✔ Web-Based Access for Multi-Device Compatibility
  • ✔ Seamless Integration with FactoryTalk View SCADA.
  • 4. FactoryTalk ViewPoint – Web-Based SCADA Access

    FactoryTalk ViewPoint extends SCADA functionality to web browsers, enabling remote monitoring and control from anywhere. It provides a secure, real-time interface for plant operators and managers.

    Key Features:
  • ✔ Browser-Based Access – No client installation required.
  • ✔ Real-Time Data Display & Control.
  • ✔ Role-Based Security & User Authentication.
  • ✔ Compatible with FactoryTalk View SE & ME.

title: Best Solar Charge Controller for Home & Industrial Use
description: Get the right Solar Charge Controller for efficient battery management and longer system life. Ideal for home and industrial solar power solutions.
heading: Solar Charge Controller
content:
Solar Charge Controller

Exelcius Automation offers PWM and MPPT types solar charge controller. It is a very crucial device in solar power systems that regulates the voltage and current from solar panels to prevent overcharging or deep discharge of batteries. It ensures efficient energy management and extends battery life.

Key functions:

  • Voltage Regulation
    Protects batteries from deep discharge, improving longevity.
  • Reverse Current Protection
    Stops battery discharge at night when no solar energy is available.
  • Multiple Charging Stages
    Uses bulk, absorption, and float charging for optimal battery health.

Types:

  • PWM (Pulse Width Modulation):
    Cost-effective, suitable for small solar systems.
  • MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking):
    More efficient, extracts maximum power from solar panels, ideal for larger installations.

Applications:

  • Off-grid and hybrid solar power systems.
  • Solar street lighting.
  • RVs, boats, and remote power setups.
  • Solar home and commercial energy storage.

heading: Surge Protective Devices (SPD)
content:
Surge Protective Devices (SPD)

Exelcius Automation provides Type 1, Type 2, and Type 3 Surge Protective Devices of different makes.

Surge Protective Devices (SPDs) are essential electrical components designed to protect electrical systems and equipment from voltage spikes and transient overvoltages caused by lightning strikes, power surges, or switching operations.

Key Features:

  • Voltage Regulation

    Limits excess voltage to prevent damage.

  • Multiple Protection Levels

    Available for different applications, including industrial, commercial, and residential use.

  • Fast Response Time

    Reacts in nanoseconds to divert surges safely to the ground.

  • Thermal Protection

    Equipped with safety mechanisms to prevent overheating and failure.

Types of SPDs

  • Type 1:

    Installed at the main service entrance to protect against direct lightning strikes.

  • Type 2:

    Used at distribution panels for protection against indirect surges.

  • Type 3:

    Installed at the equipment level (e.g., power strips) for localized protection.

Applications:

  • Electrical panels in homes and industries.
  • Telecommunication networks.
  • Data centers and IT infrastructure.
  • Renewable energy systems (solar and wind).

By preventing damage to sensitive equipment, SPDs enhance electrical system reliability, reduce downtime, and improve safety, making them crucial for modern power distribution networks

title: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) | Exelcius Automation
description: Get reliable Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) solutions from Exelcius Automation. Ensure continuous power backup, protect equipment, and maintain productivity
heading: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) Solutions for Industrial and Infrastructure Applications
content:
Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) Solutions for Industrial and Infrastructure Applications

In today's fast-paced industrial and infrastructure sectors, power reliability is critical for maintaining seamless operations, preventing data loss, and safeguarding equipment. Exelcius Automation partners with leading global brands such as Eaton, Delta, and Schneider Electric to offer a diverse range of Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) solutions. Our UPS systems are engineered to provide dependable backup power and power conditioning, ensuring that businesses operate without disruption in the face of power failures, fluctuations, or surges.

Why UPS is Crucial for Industry and Infrastructure

Industries and infrastructure projects require uninterrupted power for mission-critical operations. Applications in data centers, manufacturing plants, healthcare facilities, tunnels, highways, and other infrastructure setups depend heavily on UPS systems to :

  • Protect sensitive equipment from power disturbances
  • Avoid downtime caused by unexpected outages
  • Maintain continuity for automation systems and IT infrastructure
  • Safeguard critical data

Exelcius Automation's UPS Solutions Portfolio

We offer a wide range of UPS systems from Eaton, Delta, and Schneider Electric, catering to varied applications across industries. Below is an overview of the UPS models and their features

Eaton UPS Systems

Eaton is a globally recognized leader in power management, known for its reliable and high-performance UPS solutions.

Key Models for Industry and Infrastructure Applications

  • • Eaton 9SX and 9PX Series (1-3 Phase) : Designed for critical applications in industrial environments, these models provide high-efficiency power backup with features like double-conversion topology, extended runtime options, and advanced monitoring capabilities.

  • • Eaton 93E and 93PM Series : Tailored for medium to large-scale industries and infrastructure, these three-phase UPS systems deliver up to 99% efficiency in energy-saving mode while offering robust protection against power fluctuations.

  • • Eaton 91PS and 93PS Series : These models offer modular designs, scalable runtimes, and advanced communication options, making them ideal for data centers, hospitals, and critical infrastructure applications.

Key Features of Eaton UPS :-

• Double-conversion technology for stable power delivery

• Energy-efficient modes with low operating costs

• Intelligent monitoring and management via Eaton’s Intelligent Power Manager (IPM) software

• Compact designs for space-saving installations

Delta UPS Systems

Delta is a leading provider of energy-efficient UPS systems, combining innovative technology with reliable performance for industrial and infrastructure clients.

Key Models for Industry and Infrastructure Applications

  • • Delta Amplon Series (Single Phase) : Compact, high-performance UPS systems designed for small to medium-sized industrial facilities and IT rooms. These systems provide up to 96% efficiency and superior power density.

  • • Delta Ultron Series (Three Phase) : These medium- to large-scale UPS solutions are ideal for industrial automation systems, ensuring consistent power for critical operations. Models like the HPH and DPS series offer 98% efficiency and a robust design for challenging environments.

  • • Delta Modulon Series : Designed for large-scale applications, this modular UPS system features hot-swappable modules, redundancy options, and scalability to meet future expansion needs.

Key Features of Delta UPS :-

• Wide input voltage range for industrial environments

• High efficiency for energy savings

• Modular design for easy scalability and maintenance

• Advanced battery management for extended battery life

Schneider Electric UPS Systems

Schneider Electric is a trusted name in the power solutions industry, offering robust and innovative UPS systems for critical industrial and infrastructure applications.

Key Models for Industry and Infrastructure Applications

  • • APC Smart-UPS Series : A versatile line of single-phase UPS systems suitable for IT rooms, small automation setups, and industrial applications. These models provide pure sine wave output and network-grade power reliability.

  • • Galaxy VS Series : Compact and highly efficient three-phase UPS designed for medium-sized facilities and industrial setups. The Galaxy VS offers up to 99% efficiency in ECOnversion mode and features modular scalability.

  • • Galaxy VX and Galaxy VL Series : Built for large-scale industrial plants, data centers, and infrastructure projects, these UPS systems provide advanced battery technologies (like Lithium-ion), high efficiency, and seamless integration into energy management systems.

Key Features of Schneider UPS :-

• Flexible configurations for industrial and IT environments

• Intelligent EcoStruxure monitoring for real-time diagnostics

• High energy efficiency and low total cost of ownership (TCO)

• Advanced battery solutions for improved performance and longevity
